inria_digital_hiding.description: INRIA-Person digital hiding attacks, overall rows from Table 1. Higher mAP.5 and AR indicate better defended person detection; clean-image mAP.5 tracks preservation of benign performance.

attack_mAP5.description: Detection quality on attacked hiding images; higher means the defense recovers more true people.

attack_AR.description: Average recall under hiding attacks; complements mAP.5 with recall-oriented recovery.

clean_mAP5.description: Clean-image detection quality; guards against defenses that damage benign inputs.

apricot_creating.description: APRICOT physical creating attacks, overall rows from Table 3. Lower mAP.5 and ASR indicate better suppression of false detections on adversarial patches.

targeted_mAP5.description: Patch-region detection quality for targeted creating attacks; lower means fewer target-like false detections.

targeted_ASR.description: Targeted creating attack success rate; lower means the patch less often causes the target false detection.

untargeted_mAP5.description: Patch-region detection quality for untargeted creating attacks; lower means fewer false detections of any class.

untargeted_ASR.description: Untargeted creating attack success rate; the headline metric for suppressing patch-created objects.

physical_hiding.description: Real-world physical AdvPatch hiding attack ASR from Table 2, averaged across indoor, outdoor lighting, and outdoor shadow conditions for YOLOv3 and Faster R-CNN. Lower ASR is better.

yolov3_ASR.description: Physical hiding attack success rate against YOLOv3; lower means the person remains detectable.

faster_rcnn_ASR.description: Physical hiding attack success rate against Faster R-CNN; lower means the person remains detectable.

overall_ASR.description: Average physical hiding attack success rate across detectors and environments; lower is better.

synthetic_hiding_scaled.description: Scaled synthetic hiding benchmark used by this reproduction. Higher recall-at-IoU-0.5 proxy scores indicate better defended detection under hiding patches; clean recall tracks preservation of benign detections.

attack_mAP5.description: Person recall at IoU 0.5 on hiding-attack images; the scaled proxy for defended detection quality.

attack_AR.description: Mean person recall across stricter IoU thresholds on hiding-attack images; catches sloppy boxes tuned only for IoU 0.5.

attack_precision.description: Person precision on hiding-attack images; penalizes methods that recover recall by hallucinating extra people.

clean_mAP5.description: Person recall at IoU 0.5 on clean images; preserves the paper's benign-performance constraint.

clean_precision.description: Person precision on clean images; catches defenses that introduce benign-scene false positives.

synthetic_hiding_scaled.notes: Scaled synthetic reference values are from the validated reproduction artifacts, not the full paper benchmark.

synthetic_creating_scaled.description: Scaled synthetic creating benchmark used by this reproduction. Lower patch-overlap false-positive rates indicate better suppression of patch-created detections.

targeted_mAP5.description: Strict patch-overlap false-positive rate on creating images; lower means fewer target-like detections centered on the patch.

targeted_ASR.description: Moderate-overlap false-positive rate on creating images; lower means stronger suppression of patch-created objects.

untargeted_mAP5.description: Loose patch-overlap false-positive rate on creating images; lower catches broad false detections near the patch.

untargeted_ASR.description: Any-overlap patch false-positive rate on creating images; the hardest-to-game creating suppression metric.

object_mAP5.description: Person recall on creating images; prevents methods from suppressing patches by erasing all objects.

synthetic_creating_scaled.notes: Scaled synthetic reference values are from the validated reproduction artifacts, not the full paper benchmark.

rectification_ablation.description: Scaled synthetic rectification ablation corresponding to Appendix A.1: direct regenerated image versus full DISPATCH rectification. Higher attack mAP.5 indicates better recovery under hiding attack.

attack_mAP5.description: Person recall at IoU 0.5 under hiding attack; tests whether rectification improves over direct regeneration.

attack_AR.description: Mean person recall across stricter IoU thresholds; catches rectification variants with imprecise boxes.

attack_precision.description: Person precision under hiding attack; penalizes rectification variants that add false people.

rectification_ablation.notes: Scaled synthetic reference values are from the validated reproduction artifacts, not the full paper benchmark.
